model_annotation: The chart illustrates negative log probability values for “per-specialty terms” across six medical specialties, showing clustered bars for each specialty term set and separate colors corresponding to a base model and models fine-tuned on different specialties. The horizontal axis contains the category groups labeled (left to right) Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, with the axis label “Per-specialty terms.” The vertical axis is labeled “Negative log probability” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately −22, −23, −24, −25, −26, and −27, spanning roughly from −22 at the top to −27 at the bottom; the bars extend downward from near the top of the plotting area to their negative values. A legend at the top indicates one light-blue series for “Mistralv0.2-Base” and six warm-toned series for fine-tuning domains (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics). Within each specialty group, multiple narrow bars are placed side-by-side in the legend’s order; for Cardio terms, the light-blue base bar reaches about −26.7 and the fine-tuned bars cluster around roughly −25.7 to −26.1; for Gastro terms, the base bar is about −24.9 and the fine-tuned bars are around −23.8 to −24.2; for Infect terms, the base bar is about −23.7 and the fine-tuned bars span roughly −22.8 to −23.2; for Neuro terms, the base bar is about −25.3 and the fine-tuned bars run about −24.0 to −24.7; for Obstetrics terms, the base bar is about −24.8 and the fine-tuned bars are around −23.7 to −24.1; and for Pediatrics terms, the base bar is about −24.7 and the fine-tuned bars are around −23.6 to −24.0. The category groups appear in a fixed specialty order rather than being sorted by bar height, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with outlines, annotations, or special shading beyond the color coding.
